title: 第13章 雷火貂
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

入夜后。

和铃来看望小麒麟。

她带了一把灵草，怼到小麒麟嘴边。

小麒麟把脑袋别过去，腹腔中发出呼呼的声音。

和铃挪到右边，继续喂它。

“呕……”小麒麟忽然低头，吐了大口青草汁出来。

和铃：“！！！”

“你干什么！”她迅速起身，退了两大步远。

小麒麟心虚地转着眼珠子，细声细气叫唤：“吟～吟～”

吃撑了。反胃，就吐了。

“嗝～”小麒麟又打了个饱嗝。

在和铃来之前，已经有十几批南华宗弟子来给它喂食。

和铃摸出一张清洁符处理了下衣裳，嫌弃地踢了踢裙摆，把草丢在地上，说道：“要是七日后你选了我，今天的事情就不和你计较了。”

“但是——”

她哼了声，威胁道：“你忘恩负义的话，我们之间的账就要好好重新算一下了。”

小麒麟歪了歪脑袋。

什么恩，什么义？

大家都给它送吃的了呀，好多人都对它有恩呢。

和铃走后，又有一个弟子提着水桶前来。

声音谄媚地说道：“小神兽，我给你洗一洗身上吧～”

小麒麟起身，身上的锁链哗啦作响，它凑近到水桶前，低头吸了半桶的水。

这弟子恍然大悟：“是了，大家都给小麒麟送吃的，没有给它喂水，小麒麟肯定口渴了……”

“噗——”

忽然，一道水柱喷在了他的脸上。

小麒麟舔了舔嘴巴。

嗯，漱口之后舒服多了。

Page (1/3)

After nightfall.

He Ling came to visit Xiao Qilin.

She brought a handful of spiritual grass and put it to Little Qilin's mouth.

Little Qilin turned his head away and made a whirring sound in his abdomen.

He Ling moved to the right and continued to feed it.

"Ugh..." Little Qilin suddenly lowered his head and spit out a large mouthful of grass juice.

He Ling: "!!!"

"What are you doing!" She stood up quickly and took two big steps back.

Little Qilin rolled his eyes guiltily and called out softly: "Yin~Yin~"

Too full.I felt nauseated and vomited.

"Hiccup~" Little Qilin burped again.

Before He Ling came, more than a dozen groups of Nanhua Sect disciples had come to feed it.

He Ling took out a cleaning charm and disposed of his clothes, kicked the hem of his skirt in disgust, threw the grass on the ground, and said, "If you choose me in seven days, I won't care about you today."

"But-"

She snorted and threatened: "If you are ungrateful, the accounts between us will be recalculated."

Little Qilin tilted his head.

What grace, what righteousness?

Everyone gave it food, and many people were kind to it.

After He Ling left, another disciple came with a bucket.

The voice said flatteringly: "Little beast, let me wash your body~"

The little Qilin stood up, the chains on his body rattling, he came closer to the bucket, lowered his head and drank half of the bucket of water.

The disciple suddenly realized: "Yes, everyone brought food to the little Qilin, but did not give it water. The little Qilin must be thirsty..."

"Pfft——"

Suddenly, a jet of water sprayed on his face.

Little Qilin licked his mouth.

Well, I feel much better after rinsing my mouth.
